account.definition: Actual persisted account snapshots at exact observed timestamps and per-observation deltas, not interpolated daily values or a synthetic initial-capital row.
account.left_reason: No corresponding admitted economic observation has been compared yet.
account.right_reason: No corresponding admitted economic observation has been compared yet.

candidates.definition: Saved candidate selection/eligibility/rank/score observations, grouped by stage and instrument as ordinal-preserving multisets. Missing rows are not automatically non-selection.

events.definition: Full outer source-event pairing, never date-only or random-ID pairing; both exact decision pre-states are retained. Execution-result snapshots are separate from decision callbacks.

features.definition: Saved feature IDs and values, validity and cutoff, preserving duplicate IDs and source ordinals. Uncollected features are not evaluated again.

fills.definition: Actual individual fill rows, explicitly linked to their local orders. These are not closed trades; missing fills do not establish missing order intent.
fills.left_reason: No corresponding admitted economic observation has been compared yet.
fills.right_reason: No corresponding admitted economic observation has been compared yet.

holding_duration.definition: Actual closed-trade entry-to-exit elapsed seconds where retained; open positions are right-censored at the last observed account timestamp and unknown entry dates/durations remain null.
holding_duration.left_reason: No corresponding admitted economic observation has been compared yet.
holding_duration.right_reason: No corresponding admitted economic observation has been compared yet.

orders.definition: Actual admitted economic orders and explicit decision/logical/child ID graph. Cross-run equality uses a documented semantic projection with graph topology, retaining every original ID and duplicate multiplicity.
orders.left_reason: No corresponding admitted economic observation has been compared yet.
orders.right_reason: No corresponding admitted economic observation has been compared yet.

positions.definition: Actual persisted position snapshots at exact observed timestamps. Missing rows are unknown, never synthesized flat positions; path differences are not isolated rule effects.
positions.left_reason: No corresponding admitted economic observation has been compared yet.
positions.right_reason: No corresponding admitted economic observation has been compared yet.

predicates.definition: Saved predicate IDs, operands and evaluation states, preserving duplicate IDs and source ordinals. False is distinct from not evaluated, unknown and not sampled.

targets.definition: Raw targets and constrained plans compared separately. Omission/preserve is not an explicit zero target or liquidation; targets are not actual fills.

turnover.definition: Gross observed-window turnover = sum(abs(fill quantity × fill price)) / arithmetic mean of positive observed account equity, over the stated window. Not annualized, not one-way turnover, and not certified complete-session coverage.
turnover.left_reason: Some compared observations have incomplete coverage or ambiguous absence; only explicitly recorded values are shown.
turnover.right_reason: Some compared observations have incomplete coverage or ambiguous absence; only explicitly recorded values are shown.
